instr: Tiles: slide the numbered tiles into the gap until they are in order from 1 to 8.
clue: Put the tiles in order as in the target picture: 1 to 8, with the gap at the bottom right. Click a tile next to the gap to slide it in, or use the arrow keys (or arrow buttons) to move a tile into the gap. Try to use as few moves as you can. Press Start when ready.
illegal: Only a tile next to the gap can move.
